notes:
XTrace 0.2.0 adds an opt-in leaderboard and a new session warning.

- Leaderboard: pick a nickname and confirm with a code sent to your email to list your 7-day leverage on leaderboard.xtrace.ai. Nothing is sent until you join, other users never see your email, and Leave deletes your entry.
- Admitted mistake: a new session warning when an agent's reply admits a mistake right after your message. The repeated-calls warning is removed.
- Redesigned warning window: the conversation reads as a chat beside why it was flagged, and a diagnosis keeps running after you close the window.
- Codex Desktop forks now show their conversation.
- Effort: a day's summary moved into the box that opens on its date.
- After this update, XTrace reads older Claude conversations once more to find admitted mistakes.
- Links and updates now point to github.com/XTraceAI/xtrace.
